plain: A person who watches over and directs workers

webster.text: One who overlooks; a superintendent; a supervisor.

more.text: An officer who has the care of the poor or of an idiot, &c.

example.quote: Government, they will be nothing more than overseers for the Northern States.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, July 10, 1787
